description: Calendar Pro Plus is a free, professional date range selector for Power BI reports. Drop Calendar Pro into your report alongside a date column, and your users get a clean, intuitive way to filter the entire report by date range — with controls that go far beyond the built-in Power BI date slicer. KEY FEATURES • Six granularities in one control — switch between day, week, pay period, month, quarter, and year with a single click • Smart defaults that auto-apply on open — open a report and the visual pre-filters to today, the last date of your data, or any preset you choose (last 7 days, year-to-date, this quarter, last month, etc.) • Two-direction range picker — start and end dates with calendar pickers, plus quick-jump arrows for next or previous period • Configurable week-start day and fiscal year — handles non-standard fiscal calendars and pay periods • Customizable display formats — control how dates render in headers and labels • Light and dark theme modes — automatically follows your Power BI report theme • Bookmarks and persisted filter state — works seamlessly with Power BI bookmarks • Cross-filters the entire report — your other visuals respond instantly LOCALES SUPPORTED English (US and AU), Spanish, French, Dutch.
